MATCH_SHORT/MATCH_LONG ... }","note":"A crafted repetitive payload can force a match/run encoding path that writes compressed tokens into the output buffer."},
  {"step":7,"file":"c-blosc/blosc/blosclz.c","function":"blosclz_compress","line":548,"var":"op","code":"*(uint8_t*)output |= (1U << 5U); return (int)(op - (uint8_t*)output);","note":"The compressor finalizes the encoded stream by writing the marker byte and returning the produced size; the vulnerable write occurs earlier in the token emission path when output accounting is insufficient."}
